To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
big data analytics (BDA) has the potential to enhance the sustainability of supply chains, and the adoption of BDA is contingent upon the supply chain context.

the application of big data analytics in supply chains can lead to improved performance, and that the application of the big data analytics in SCM is not only beneficial for the supply chain as a whole, but also for individual supply chain actors.

the adoption of Big Data and Predictive Analytics is positively related to supply chain sustainability, and that this relationship is stronger when the supply chain is characterized by a high degree of integration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of BDPA in SCM and its impact on sustainable SCM.
the use of predictive analytics to improve supply chain sustainability.
the application of big data analytics to supply chain management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
big data is the future of the supply chain.
big data analytics is a powerful tool that has a lot of potential to be applied to the.
big data analytics can be used for supply chain management to achieve the goals of sustainability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the importance of big data and predictive analytics in supply chain management and how it impacts the financial and strategic performance of the firm.
the use of big data in supply chains has a significant positive impact on financial/strategic supply chain performance.
the use of big data and predictive analytics in the supply chain has the potential to increase the efficiency, effectiveness, and profitability of the supply chain.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of big data and predictive analytics in supply chains is not only a matter of having access to data, but also a matter of being able to use it to make decisions that are aligned with the strategic objectives of the firm.
the use of BDPA can enhance and enable sustainable supply chains.
the big data revolution is here, and it’s changing the world.
